label: DESI DR2 flat-LambdaCDM fit with mild BAO-CMB tension
summary: DESI reported that its DR2 BAO results were well described by a flat LambdaCDM model while the parameters preferred by BAO were in mild 2.3-sigma tension with those determined from the CMB.

sources.title: DESI DR2 Results II: Measurements of Baryon Acoustic Oscillations and Cosmological Constraints

label: DES Y6 reported weak preference for evolving dark energy
summary: The DES Collaboration reported that its analyzed probe combinations supported a weak preference for evolving dark energy, with the significance of deviation from a cosmological constant ranging from 2.3 to 3.2 sigma when individual probes were left out.

sources.title: Constraints on Dynamical Dark Energy from Multiple Probes in the Full Dark Energy Survey
